SELECT count(*) totalNum, sum(s.amount) totalAmount, 6 type, #{numberType} numberType FROM (SELECT a.store_id, sum(a.order_amount) AS amount FROM (SELECT order_amount, store_id FROM scm_order${tableFix0} WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND delivery_line_name = '社会店专线' AND project_name = '浪大勺' AND store_name not like '%（异常，外售）%' AND warehouse_name != '测试仓库勿动' AND warehouse_name != '测试专用仓库' AND order_type = 0 AND order_status != 7 AND order_status != 70 AND order_status != 0 UNION ALL SELECT order_amount, store_id FROM scm_order${tableFix1} WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND delivery_line_name = '社会店专线' AND project_name = '浪大勺' AND store_name not like '%（异常，外售）%' AND warehouse_name != '测试仓库勿动' AND warehouse_name != '测试专用仓库' AND order_type = 0 AND order_status != 7 AND order_status != 70 AND order_status != 0) a GROUP BY store_id) s

SELECT w.warehouse_name warehouseName, ss.amount totalAmount, ss.cnt totalNum, #{numberType} numberType FROM (SELECT * FROM scm_warehouse WHERE is_delete = 0 AND warehouse_name != '测试仓库勿动' AND warehouse_name != '测试专用仓库' AND warehouse_name != '沈阳仓样品库' AND warehouse_name NOT LIKE '%丰裕%' ORDER BY id) w LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.warehouse_id, count(*) cnt, sum(s.amount) amount FROM (SELECT a.warehouse_id, a.store_id, sum(a.order_amount) AS amount FROM (SELECT store_id, order_amount, warehouse_id FROM scm_order${tableFix0} WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND project_code = 1 AND delivery_line_name != '外地发货线' AND delivery_line_name != '社会店专线' AND store_name NOT LIKE '%220%' AND delivery_line_name != '总部线路' AND order_type = 0 AND order_status != 7 AND order_status != 70 AND order_status != 0 UNION ALL SELECT store_id, order_amount, warehouse_id FROM scm_order${tableFix1} WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND project_code = 1 AND delivery_line_name != '外地发货线' AND delivery_line_name != '社会店专线' AND store_name NOT LIKE '%220%' AND delivery_line_name != '总部线路' AND order_type = 0 AND order_status != 7 AND order_status != 70 AND order_status != 0) a GROUP BY warehouse_id, store_id) s GROUP BY s.warehouse_id) ss ON ss.warehouse_id = w.id

SELECT spu.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, spu.stastics_commodity_name AS commodityName, IF (b.commodityAmount IS NOT NULL, b.commodityAmount, 0) AS totalAmount, IF (b.commodityAmount IS NOT NULL, ROUND(b.commodityAmount / bt.commodityAmount, 4), 0.0000) AS proportion, #{numberType} numberType FROM (SELECT warehouse_id, warehouse_name, commodity_name, stastics_commodity_name FROM scm_commodity WHERE is_delete = 0 AND stastics_commodity_name IS NOT NULL AND warehouse_name != '测试仓库勿动' AND warehouse_name != '测试专用仓库' AND warehouse_name != '沈阳仓样品库' AND project_code = 1 GROUP BY warehouse_id, stastics_commodity_name) spu LEFT JOIN (SELECT k.warehouse_id, k.stastics_commodity_name, sum(k.commodity_amount) commodityAmount FROM (SELECT od.warehouse_id, od.stastics_commodity_name, od.commodity_amount FROM scm_order_detail${tableFix0} od LEFT JOIN scm_order${tableFix0} o ON o.id = od.order_id WHERE o.order_status != 7 AND o.order_status != 70 AND o.order_status != 0 AND o.order_type = 0 AND o.project_code = 1 AND o.delivery_line_name != '外地发货线' AND o.delivery_line_name != '社会店专线' AND o.store_name NOT LIKE '%220%' AND o.delivery_line_name != '总部线路' AND od.stastics_commodity_name IS NOT NULL AND o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time <= #{endTime} UNION ALL SELECT od.warehouse_id, od.stastics_commodity_name, od.commodity_amount FROM scm_order_detail${tableFix1} od LEFT JOIN scm_order${tableFix1} o ON o.id = od.order_id WHERE o.order_status != 7 AND o.order_status != 70 AND o.order_status != 0 AND o.order_type = 0 AND o.project_code = 1 AND o.delivery_line_name != '外地发货线' AND o.delivery_line_name != '社会店专线' AND o.store_name NOT LIKE '%220%' AND o.delivery_line_name != '总部线路' AND od.stastics_commodity_name IS NOT NULL AND o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time <= #{endTime}) k GROUP BY k.warehouse_id, k.stastics_commodity_name) b ON b.stastics_commodity_name = spu.stastics_commodity_name AND b.warehouse_id = spu.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT k.warehouse_id, sum(k.commodity_amount) commodityAmount FROM (SELECT od.warehouse_id, od.commodity_amount FROM scm_order_detail${tableFix0} od LEFT JOIN scm_order${tableFix0} o ON o.id = od.order_id WHERE o.order_status != 7 AND o.order_status != 70 AND o.order_status != 0 AND o.order_type = 0 AND o.delivery_line_name != '外地发货线' AND o.delivery_line_name != '社会店专线' AND o.store_name NOT LIKE '%220%' AND o.delivery_line_name != '总部线路' AND od.stastics_commodity_name IS NOT NULL AND o.project_code = 1 AND o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time <= #{endTime} UNION ALL SELECT od.warehouse_id, od.commodity_amount FROM scm_order_detail${tableFix1} od LEFT JOIN scm_order${tableFix1} o ON o.id = od.order_id WHERE o.order_status != 7 AND o.order_status != 70 AND o.order_status != 0 AND o.order_type = 0 AND o.project_code = 1 AND o.delivery_line_name != '外地发货线' AND o.delivery_line_name != '社会店专线' AND o.store_name NOT LIKE '%220%' AND o.delivery_line_name != '总部线路' AND od.stastics_commodity_name IS NOT NULL AND o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time <= #{endTime}) k GROUP BY k.warehouse_id) bt ON bt.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id ORDER BY spu.warehouse_id, b.commodityAmount DESC

SELECT store.store_name storeName, IF (s.payAmount IS NOT NULL, s.payAmount, 0.00) AS totalAmount, IF (s.orderCnt IS NOT NULL, s.orderCnt, 0) AS totalNum, #{numberType} numberType FROM (SELECT store_id, store_name, warehouse_name FROM system_store_info WHERE store_name NOT LIKE '%总部%' AND store_name NOT LIKE '%测试%' AND store_name NOT LIKE '%零零%' AND store_name != '图洛' AND business_id = 10) store LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.store_id, sum(a.pay_amount) payAmount, count(*) AS orderCnt FROM (SELECT store_id, pay_amount FROM bz_order${tableFix0} WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND order_state != 0 AND order_state != 70 AND order_state != 10 AND order_state != 100 AND order_state != 90 AND order_state != - 10 UNION ALL SELECT store_id, pay_amount FROM bz_order${tableFix1} WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND order_state != 0 AND order_state != 70 AND order_state != 10 AND order_state != 100 AND order_state != 90 AND order_state != - 10) a GROUP BY store_id) s ON s.store_id = store.store_id -- WHERE s.orderCnt IS NOT NULL -- AND s.orderCnt > 0

IF (s.amount IS NOT NULL, s.amount, 0) / 7 AS buyAmount, IF (xs.orderCnt IS NOT NULL, xs.orderCnt, 0) / 7 AS totalNum, IF (xs.payAmount IS NOT NULL, xs.payAmount, 0) / 7 AS totalAmount,
IF (s.amount IS NOT NULL, s.amount, 0) AS buyAmount, IF (xs.orderCnt IS NOT NULL, xs.orderCnt, 0) AS totalNum, IF (xs.payAmount IS NOT NULL, xs.payAmount, 0) AS totalAmount,
#{numberType} numberType FROM (SELECT store_id, store_name, warehouse_name FROM system_store_info WHERE store_name NOT LIKE '%总部%' AND store_name NOT LIKE '%测试%' AND store_name NOT LIKE '%零零%' AND store_name != '图洛' AND business_id = 10 AND del_flag = 0) store LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.store_id, sum(a.order_amount) AS amount, count(*) AS totalCnt FROM (SELECT order_amount, store_id FROM scm_order${tableFix0} WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND project_code = 1 AND delivery_line_name != '外地发货线' AND delivery_line_name != '社会店专线' AND store_name NOT LIKE '%220%' AND delivery_line_name != '总部线路' AND warehouse_name != '测试仓库勿动' AND order_type = 0 AND order_status != 7 AND order_status != 70 AND order_status != 0 UNION ALL SELECT order_amount, store_id FROM scm_order${tableFix1} WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND project_code = 1 AND delivery_line_name != '外地发货线' AND delivery_line_name != '社会店专线' AND store_name NOT LIKE '%220%' AND delivery_line_name != '总部线路' AND warehouse_name != '测试仓库勿动' AND order_type = 0 AND order_status != 7 AND order_status != 70 AND order_status != 0) a GROUP BY store_id) s ON s.store_id = store.store_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.store_id, count(*) AS orderCnt, sum(a.pay_amount) AS payAmount FROM (SELECT store_id, pay_amount FROM bz_order${tableFix0} WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND order_state != 0 AND order_state != 70 AND order_state != 10 AND order_state != 100 AND order_state != 90 AND order_state != - 10 UNION ALL SELECT store_id, pay_amount FROM bz_order${tableFix1} WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND order_state != 0 AND order_state != 70 AND order_state != 10 AND order_state != 100 AND order_state != 90 AND order_state != - 10) a GROUP BY store_id) xs ON xs.store_id = store.store_id WHERE -- (s.amount IS NOT NULL OR xs.orderCnt IS NOT NULL) AND store.warehouse_name IS NOT NULL

SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT a.store_id, count(*) c FROM (SELECT store_id FROM bz_order${tableFix0} WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND order_state != 0 AND order_state != 70 AND order_state != 10 AND order_state != 100 AND order_state != 90 AND order_state != - 10 AND business_id = 10 AND store_name NOT LIKE '%总部%' AND store_name NOT LIKE '%测试%' AND store_name NOT LIKE '%零零%' AND store_name != '图洛' UNION ALL SELECT store_id FROM bz_order${tableFix1} WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND order_state != 0 AND order_state != 70 AND order_state != 10 AND order_state != 100 AND order_state != 90 AND order_state != - 10 AND business_id = 10 AND store_name NOT LIKE '%总部%' AND store_name NOT LIKE '%测试%' AND store_name NOT LIKE '%零零%' AND store_name != '图洛') a GROUP BY a.store_id HAVING c > 0 ) b
